title: To All My Republican (and Libertarian) Readers

body:
I’m grateful for all the conservative/independent readers of my books, blog, Facebook, and Twitter … you put up with a lot of my rants and you read from me a lot of things that you disagree with. I wanted to share this video from a Republican, Trump-supporting, gun-toting co-founder of the Tea Party … something I deeply agree with. I hope you’ll enjoy this and share it,
